events.title: The demo is part of Steam Next Fest
events.summary: From today until October 26, What the Buck?! is part of Steam Next Fest. What is in the demo $1, $2 and $5 bills, plus coins Gold, Electric and Explosive Bills Shifts: end one, spend your Prestige Points and start the next one stronger Auto Swiper and Frenzy from the prestige tree The demo takes about an hour. Your save carries over The full version comes out on November 9. When you start it, it offers to take over your demo save. Tell me what you think If something is unclear, too slow or broke

events.title: Next Fest stream: What the Buck?! gameplay on loop
events.summary: This is a recorded run of the full game. It starts at an empty table with $0 and goes far into the late game, about 80 minutes before it starts over. It plays on loop from October 19 to October 26. Play the demo The free demo is on the store page. Your demo progress carries over to the full game. Out November 9 Wishlist What the Buck?! to get a Steam notification when it is out.

events.title: What the Buck?! comes out on November 9
events.summary: November 9 What the Buck?! comes out on Monday, November 9, at 19:00 CET (10:00 PST). It costs $6.99, and it is 30% off for the first 14 days. What the full version adds $10, $20, $50 and $100 bills Collector Bills, which pull in the bills around them and pay out everything they hold Fuel Bills and a flamethrower that sets the table on fire Diamonds, which shatter into shards that cut through the stacks Investment Papers: stock certificates whose price rises and falls until you cash out A second
